question: The ratio of the two sides of a rectangle is 2 : 3. If the area of the rectangle is 2646 cm², then its perimeter is ______ cm.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of sides = 2 : 3 ⇒ Area parts = 2 × 3 = 6

6 units² = 2646 ⇒ 1 unit² = 441

1 unit = √441 = 21 cm

Perimeter units = 2 × (2 + 3) = 10 units

Perimeter = 10 × 21 = 210

**∴ The correct answer is 210.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of sides = 2 : 3

Area of rectangle = 2646 cm²

**Formula Used:**

Area = Length × Breadth

Perimeter = 2 × (Length + Breadth)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/62d1af82bf2e90bf7cd125b69ccd79ef186dafd664444ac1015a81b8850945b5.png] 

Let the sides of the rectangle be 2x and 3x.

⇒ Area = 2x × 3x

⇒ 2646 = 6x²

⇒ x² = 2646 ÷ 6

⇒ x² = 441

⇒ x = √441 = 21 cm

⇒ Length = 3 × 21 = 63 cm

⇒ Breadth = 2 × 21 = 42 cm

⇒ Perimeter = 2 × (63 + 42)

⇒ Perimeter = 2 × 105 = 210 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 210.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Rectangle Dimensions

The area of a rectangle is the product of its adjacent sides (Length × Breadth), while the perimeter is the sum of all its boundary sides.

Diagonal Property

The diagonal of a rectangle forms a right-angled triangle with the sides; hence, Diagonal = √(Length² + Breadth²).

Ratio and Area

If the sides are in the ratio a : b, the area is proportional to a × b × x², where x is the common multiplier.
